boundary: Only acquisition and cached movement intent; World, capacities, grip depth and RB defaults unchanged.

measurement.contact: Actual positive grip or torso load; acquisition and proximity alone are not contact.
measurement.samples: Actual live 20 Hz boundaries; own-load and paired control-load clocks are separate.
measurement.censoring: Time-limit holds remain censored; only physical fall or existing progress whistle earns a finish.
measurement.advance: Compare completed field end spots, not different-time relative-to-acquisition clocks.
measurement.probes: Recorded control movement/grip substitutions are diagnostic only; final policy uses its own cached command and felt queued/ongoing strike.
